questions.question: Find the area of a parallelogram, whose base is (3x − 5y + 4) m and height is (x - 5y) m.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of Parallelogram** = **Base** × **Height**.

Multiply (3x − 5y + 4) by (x − 5y).

⇒ 3x(x − 5y) − 5y(x − 5y) + 4(x − 5y)

⇒ 3x² − 15xy − 5xy + 25y² + 4x − 20y

⇒ 3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y

**∴ The correct answer is (3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Base (b)** = (3x − 5y + 4) m

**Height (h)** = (x − 5y) m

**Formula Used:**

**Area of a Parallelogram** = Base × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb7bad234341248f5a9d1a5d6c3762cdfde7ae1574b8dc2db92af22a6aa2abb0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (3x − 5y + 4) × (x − 5y)

⇒ Area = 3x(x − 5y) − 5y(x − 5y) + 4(x − 5y)

⇒ Area = (3x × x) − (3x × 5y) − (5y × x) + (5y × 5y) + (4 × x) − (4 × 5y)

⇒ Area = 3x² − 15xy − 5xy + 25y² + 4x − 20y

⇒ Area = 3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y

**∴ The correct answer is (3x² + 25y² − 20xy + 4x − 20y) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Parallelogram

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. Opposite angles are equal, and diagonals bisect each other.

Perimeter of a Parallelogram

Perimeter = 2 × (sum of adjacent sides) = 2(a + b).

Area using Diagonals

If d₁ and d₂ are diagonals and θ is the angle between them, Area = 1/2 × d₁ × d₂ × sin(θ).</p

questions.question: The sides (in cm) of a right triangle are (x − 18),(x − 25) and x. Its area (in cm² ) is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Hypotenuse** as the longest side, which is **x**.

The sides must satisfy the **Pythagorean Triplets** logic.

By testing x = 85: Sides are (85 − 18) = 67, (85 − 25) = 60, and 85.

Check: 60² + 61²? No. Test x = 88: Sides are 70, 63, 88. No.

Using **x = 88**: Sides are 70, 63, 88. Test **x = 93**: Sides are 75, 68, 93. No.

Actually, x = 73 gives sides 55, 48, 73. 55² + 48² = 3025 + 2304 = 5329 = 73². Correct.

Area = 1/2 × 55 × 48 = 55 × 24 = 1320.

**∴ The correct answer is 1320 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides of a **right-angled triangle** are (x − 18), (x − 25), and x.

**Formula Used:** **Pythagoras Theorem**: a² + b² = c² and **Area** = 1/2 × Base × Height.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bc3f98eb597d4addb3a4314241fa4453fc3fff7e655a8e6d407521f05ab5a85.png] 

⇒ (x − 18)² + (x − 25)² = x²

⇒ (x² − 36x + 324) + (x² − 50x + 625) = x²

⇒ 2x² − 86x + 949 = x²

⇒ x² − 86x + 949 = 0

⇒ x² − 73x − 13x + 949 = 0

⇒ x(x − 73) − 13(x − 73) = 0

⇒ (x − 73)(x − 13) = 0

⇒ x = 73 or x = 13 (But x − 18 and x − 25 must be positive, so x > 25)

⇒ **x = 73**

⇒ Base = 73 − 25 = 48 cm, Height = 73 − 18 = 55 cm

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 48 × 55 = 24 × 55 = 1320 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1320 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

Common triplets like (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), (7, 24, 25), and (48, 55, 73) help solve right triangle problems quickly without complex algebra.

Right Triangle Area

The area of a right-angled triangle is always half the product of the two sides perpendicular to each other (Base × Height).

Quadratic Roots Selection

Always verify physical dimensions: side lengths must be positive, which often eliminates one of the two roots in a quadratic equation.</p

questions.question:
The radius of the base and the slant height of a right circular cone are 7 cm and 25 cm, respectively. Find the volume (in cm³ ) of the given cone. 

({Use } pi=(22)/(7))
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify the **Pythagorean triplet** for **radius (r)**, **height (h)**, and **slant height (l)**.

Given **r = 7** and **l = 25**, the triplet is **7, 24, 25** → **h = 24 cm**.

Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 7² × 24 = 22 × 7 × 8.

Volume = 154 × 8 = 1232 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1232 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius (r)** = 7 cm

**Slant Height (l)** = 25 cm

**Formula Used:**

Vertical height (h) = √(l² − r²)

Volume of cone (V) = (1/3)πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/648d68c05d29f78147d6c452e9bbf8936b465e4ab539a9b43ece37c224cb4c9c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ h = √(25² − 7²)

⇒ h = √(625 − 49) = √576

⇒ h = 24 cm

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 7 × 7 × 24

⇒ Volume = 22 × 7 × 8

⇒ Volume = 154 × 8 = 1232 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1232 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved surface of a right circular cone is given by **πrl**.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the curved surface area and the base area: **πr(l + r)**.

Slant Height Relation

In a right circular cone, the relation between height, radius, and slant height follows **l² = h² + r²**.</p

questions.question: A right triangle with sides 60 cm, 45 cm and 75 cm is rotated about the side of 60 cm to form a cone. The curved surface area (in cm²) of the cone so formed is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **right triangle** is rotated about its **altitude** (side), that side becomes the **height (h)** and the other side becomes the **radius (r)**.

Given sides: 60 cm (axis), 45 cm (base), 75 cm (hypotenuse).

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 45 cm, **Slant height (l)** = 75 cm.

⇒ **Curved Surface Area** = πrl = π × 45 × 75 = 3375π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3375π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sides of the **right triangle** are 60 cm, 45 cm, and 75 cm.

Rotation axis = 60 cm side.

**Formula Used:**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a **cone** = πrl

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bfcd219ab75a9e2f5e322e52aab33003a623f0b874c68d82f86e6f8579e1dda2.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ When rotated about the 60 cm side, the **height (h)** of the cone = 60 cm.

⇒ The **base radius (r)** of the cone = 45 cm.

⇒ The **slant height (l)** of the cone corresponds to the hypotenuse = 75 cm.

⇒ CSA = π × r × l

⇒ CSA = π × 45 × 75

⇒ CSA = 3375π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 3375π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cone Formation by Rotation

Rotating a right triangle about its **perpendicular** or **base** generates a cone where the axis of rotation is the height.

Slant Height Relation

The relationship between radius, height, and slant height is given by l² = r² + h².

Total Surface Area of Cone

TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r). It includes the **curved surface** and the **circular base**.</p

questions.question:
Find the circumference (in m) of the largest circle that can be inscribed in a rectangle whose dimensions are given as 112 m and 281 m.

Take pi = (22)/(7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a circle **inscribed** in a **rectangle**, the **diameter** of the **largest circle** is equal to the **smaller side** of the rectangle.

Smaller side (d) = 112 m

Circumference = πd = (22/7) × 112

Circumference = 22 × 16 = 352 m

**∴ The correct answer is 352 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of rectangle (L) = 281 m

Breadth of rectangle (B) = 112 m

**Formula Used:**

Diameter of the **largest inscribed circle** in a rectangle = **Breadth (B)**

Circumference of circle = π × diameter

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c6ac8c3979309067e0ca0decd16508145f218c785faef0bea934f5603bd6627.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Diameter (d) = 112 m

⇒ Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 112 ÷ 2 = 56 m

⇒ Circumference = 2 × π × r

⇒ Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 56

⇒ Circumference = 2 × 22 × 8

⇒ Circumference = 44 × 8 = 352 m

**∴ The correct answer is 352 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Inscribed Circle

The area of the **largest circle** that can be inscribed in a rectangle is π × (B/2)², where B is the **shorter side**.

Circle in a Square

For a **square** of side 'a', the diameter of the **inscribed circle** is exactly 'a', and the diameter of the **circumscribed circle** is a√2.

Circumference and Radius Relations

If the radius is 7 units, the circumference is 44 units and the area is 154 square units. This **ratio** is very useful for fast calculations.</p

questions.question: A solid hemisphere has a radius of 16 cm. Find its total surface area.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **solid hemisphere**, the **total surface area** is always 3×π×r².

Given **radius (r)** = 16 cm.

TSA = 3 × π × (16)²

TSA = 3 × π × 256 = 768π cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 768π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius (r)** of the **solid hemisphere** = 16 cm.

**Formula Used:**

**Total Surface Area (TSA)** of a solid hemisphere = **Curved Surface Area** + **Area of base**

TSA = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8b5cc788be39044f92dc85e8362fd9f4d8c28bab60d90d59d73121a75bca881.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ TSA = 3 × π × (16)²

⇒ TSA = 3 × π × 256

⇒ TSA = 768π cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 768π cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area of Hemisphere

The **CSA** of a hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere: CSA = 2πr².

Volume of Hemisphere

The space occupied by a hemisphere is calculated as Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Surface Area of a Sphere

For a full sphere, the total surface area is 4πr².</p

questions.question: Find the area of four walls of a cube, the length of whose edge is (3x + 8y + 5) m .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area of four walls** of a **cube** (Lateral Surface Area) = 4 × (side)².

Given side **a** = (3x + 8y + 5).

Using identity (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca.

4 × [(3x)² + (8y)² + (5)² + 2(3x)(8y) + 2(8y)(5) + 2(5)(3x)]

4 × [9x² + 64y² + 25 + 48xy + 80y + 30x] = 36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x.

**∴ The correct answer is (36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Edge** of the cube (a) = (3x + 8y + 5) m.

**Formula Used:** Area of four walls (**LSA**) = 4a².

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a836530785e64dca9cde0d77fdfef007a108011a9f1f84e0dc2de077add661c3.png] 

⇒ Area = 4 × (3x + 8y + 5)²

⇒ Area = 4 × [(3x)² + (8y)² + (5)² + 2(3x)(8y) + 2(8y)(5) + 2(5)(3x)]

⇒ Area = 4 × [9x² + 64y² + 25 + 48xy + 80y + 30x]

⇒ Area = (4 × 9x²) + (4 × 64y²) + (4 × 25) + (4 × 48xy) + (4 × 80y) + (4 × 30x)

⇒ Area = 36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x

**∴ The correct answer is (36x² + 256y² + 100 + 192xy + 320y + 120x) m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The total surface area includes all six faces and is given by 6a², where **a** is the edge length.

Volume of Cube

The space occupied by the cube is calculated using the formula **V** = a³.

Algebraic Identity

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca is essential for expanding polynomial side lengths.</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is half of its total surface area. If its height is 12 cm, then find its diameter (in cm).
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Given: **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 1/2 × **Total Surface Area (TSA)**

For a **cylinder**, if **CSA** = 1/2 **TSA**, then **2πrh** = 1/2 × 2πr(h + r)

This simplifies to **2h = h + r** ⇒ **h = r**

Given **height (h)** = 12 cm, therefore **radius (r)** = 12 cm

**Diameter** = 2 × r = 2 × 12 = 24 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Height (h)** of the cylinder = 12 cm

**Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 1/2 × **Total Surface Area (TSA)**

**Formula Used:**

**CSA** of cylinder = 2πrh

**TSA** of cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/affa048ca6b4c21009d51aab8ef9000aca45ee7da55215f77b3578c6c8de9fec.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 2πrh = 1/2 × [2πr(h + r)]

⇒ 2πrh = πr(h + r)

⇒ 2h = h + r

⇒ r = h

⇒ r = 12 cm

⇒ **Diameter (d)** = 2 × r

⇒ d = 2 × 12 = 24 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 24 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by the cylinder is given by V = πr²h.

Base Area of Cylinder

The area of the circular base or top is A = πr². TSA is the sum of CSA and twice the Base Area.

Relation between Diameter and Radius

The diameter is the longest chord of the circular base and is twice the radius (d = 2r).</p

**Height (h)** = 56 m = 5600 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter** of the wire = 6 cm

**Length (Height)** of the wire = 56 m

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **Cylinder** = πr²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6fe5b1bc233c009a4ca4816f12745c19f50c8687a62cf3dbc68df02e3941ea1.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Radius (r)** = Diameter ÷ 2 = 6/2 = 3 cm

⇒ **Length (h)** = 56 × 100 = 5600 cm

⇒ **Volume** = (22/7) × 3 × 3 × 5600

⇒ **Volume** = (22/7) × 9 × 5600

⇒ **Volume** = 22 × 9 × 800

Volume of Cylinder

The amount of space occupied by a 3D cylindrical object is πr²h, where r is the radius and h is the height.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved part of the cylinder is 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

questions.question: The length of the diagonals of a rhombus are (y + xy + 5) m and (y − xy + 7) m respectively. Find the area of the rhombus, if x = 2 and y = 1
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly substitute **x = 2** and **y = 1** into the diagonal expressions.

d₁ = (1 + 2×1 + 5) = **8 m**

d₂ = (1 − 2×1 + 7) = **6 m**

Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ = (1/2) × 8 × 6 = **24 m²**.

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First diagonal (d₁) = (y + xy + 5) m

Second diagonal (d₂) = (y − xy + 7) m

Values: **x = 2**, **y = 1**

**Formula Used:**

Area of Rhombus = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/038155b806a36920149690cb7af633a539c30f7cd384f07290f1bd0fae720b88.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ d₁ = 1 + (2 × 1) + 5

⇒ d₁ = 1 + 2 + 5 = 8 m

⇒ d₂ = 1 − (2 × 1) + 7

⇒ d₂ = 1 − 2 + 7 = 6 m

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 8 × 6

⇒ Area = 4 × 6 = 24 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 24 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rhombus

All **four sides** are equal, and **diagonals** bisect each other at **90°**.

Side and Diagonal Relationship

4 × (side)² = d₁² + d₂². This is derived from the **Pythagoras Theorem** in the internal triangles.

Perimeter of Rhombus

Perimeter = 4 × side. If only diagonals are known, side = (1/2) × √(d₁² + d₂²).</p

questions.question:
The diameter of a sphere is 2 cm more than the diameter of a smaller sphere. The surface area of the larger sphere is 528 cm² more than the surface area of the smaller sphere. What is the diameter (in cm) of the larger sphere?

Take pi = (22)/(7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the larger **diameter** be D and smaller **diameter** be d.

Given: D − d = 2 and πD² − πd² = 528

π(D² − d²) = 528 ⇒ π(D − d)(D + d) = 528

(22/7) × 2 × (D + d) = 528 ⇒ D + d = 84

Adding equations: 2D = 86 ⇒ D = 43 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 43 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Difference in **diameters** = 2 cm

Difference in **surface areas** = 528 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Surface area of sphere = 4πr² = πd² (where d is **diameter**)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e467cd743dad1f4fad97e82b3b1351b1b0f194520feef89d6199b4f1a5dd86e.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let diameter of larger sphere = D and smaller sphere = d

⇒ D = d + 2

⇒ Surface Area difference = πD² − πd² = 528

⇒ (22/7) × (D² − d²) = 528

⇒ D² − d² = (528 × 7) ÷ 22

⇒ (D − d)(D + d) = 24 × 7

⇒ 2 × (D + d) = 168

⇒ D + d = 84

⇒ (d + 2) + d = 84

⇒ 2d = 82 ⇒ d = 41 cm

⇒ D = 41 + 2 = 43 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 43 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Sphere

The volume of a sphere is given by (4/3)πr³ or (1/6)πd³.

Hemisphere Properties

Curved Surface Area = 2πr² and Total Surface Area = 3πr².

Ratio of Surface Areas

If the ratio of radii of two spheres is a:b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a²:b².</p

questions.question: A solid metal hemisphere has a radius of 6 cm. If the metal of the hemisphere is melted and recast into a cylindrical shape with the same radius, find the height of the cylinder.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When a **solid hemisphere** is melted into a **cylinder** of the same radius, equate their volumes.

Volume of Hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

Volume of Cylinder = π × r² × h

Since radii are equal: (2/3) × r = h

h = (2/3) × 6 = 4 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius of Hemisphere (r)** = 6 cm

**Radius of Cylinder (R)** = 6 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **Hemisphere** = (2/3)πr³

Volume of a **Cylinder** = πR²h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/983b4390cef9603404d996bf1f1b88edafd070850c1ca217a53b3cfff0df26cc.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of **Cylinder** = Volume of **Hemisphere**

⇒ π × (6)² × h = (2/3) × π × (6)³

⇒ 36 × h = (2/3) × 216

⇒ 36 × h = 2 × 72

⇒ 36 × h = 144

⇒ h = 144 ÷ 36

⇒ h = 4 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 4 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conversion of Solids

When one solid object is melted to form another, the **Total Volume** remains constant, provided there is no wastage of material.

Properties of a Sphere

Volume of Sphere = (4/3)πr³ and Total Surface Area = 4πr². A hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere.

Cylinder Surface Area

Curved Surface Area = 2πrh and Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r).</p

questions.question: The shorter side of a rectangle is 18 cm less than the longer side. The numerical value of its area is equal to 6 times the numerical value of its perimeter. What is the length (in cm) of its longer side ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **longer side** be **L** and **shorter side** be **(L − 18)**.

Given: **Area** = 6 × **Perimeter**

L(L − 18) = 6 × 2(L + L − 18) ⇒ L(L − 18) = 12(2L − 18)

Test options: If **L = 36**, then 36(18) = 648 and 12(72 − 18) = 12(54) = 648. Both match.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let **Longer side (Length)** = **x** cm

**Shorter side (Breadth)** = **(x − 18)** cm

**Formula Used:**

**Area of Rectangle** = Length × Breadth

**Perimeter of Rectangle** = 2(Length + Breadth)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13ff71b51a9c9df408f0fb213b8b198a63e74696a3ca603ece8cbd53b976d982.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = 6 × Perimeter

⇒ x(x − 18) = 6 × [2(x + x − 18)]

⇒ x² − 18x = 12(2x − 18)

⇒ x² − 18x = 24x − 216

⇒ x² − 42x + 216 = 0

⇒ x² − 36x − 6x + 216 = 0

⇒ x(x − 36) − 6(x − 36) = 0

⇒ (x − 36)(x − 6) = 0

⇒ x = 36 or x = 6

⇒ Since breadth = x − 18, x cannot be 6 (as side cannot be negative).

⇒ **Length** = 36 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 36 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle has opposite sides equal and all angles are 90°. Diagonal d = √(L² + B²).

Quadratic Roots Shortcut

For ax² + bx + c = 0, if the sum of roots is −b/a and product is c/a, the factors of 216 that sum to 42 are 36 and 6.</p

questions.question: The surface area of a sphere is 25pi{cm²}. The volume of the sphere is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **Surface Area** = 4πr² = 25π ⇒ r² = 25/4 ⇒ **r = 5/2 cm**.

**Volume** = (4/3)πr³ = (4/3)π(5/2)³ = (4/3)π(125/8).

On simplifying, **Volume** = (125π)/6 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 125π/6 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Surface Area of **Sphere** = 25π cm²

**Formula Used:**

⇒ Surface Area (S) = 4πr²

⇒ Volume (V) = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d1faeab838b88972428655b41bdbca7d05ffad777668fec42feb3b183f15d98.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4πr² = 25π

⇒ r² = 25/4

⇒ r = √(25/4) = 5/2 cm

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (5/2)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × π × (125/8)

⇒ Volume = (1 × π × 125) / (3 × 2)

⇒ Volume = 125π/6 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 125π/6 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Sphere

A sphere is a perfectly round geometrical object in three-dimensional space. Surface Area = 4πr² and Volume = (4/3)πr³.

Hemisphere Formulas

For a solid hemisphere, Curved Surface Area = 2πr², Total Surface Area = 3πr², and Volume = (2/3)πr³.

Ratio relations

If the ratio of radii of two spheres is a:b, then the ratio of their surface areas is a²:b² and the ratio of their volumes is a³:b³.</p

questions.question: The sides (in cm) of a right triangle are (x - 5), (x - 10) and x. Its area (in cm²) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **Right-Angled Triangle**, the sides often follow standard **Pythagorean Triplets**.

Given sides: (x − 10), (x − 5), and x. These represent sides with a constant difference of 5.

The only standard triplet with a constant difference is 3 : 4 : 5. Multiplying by 5, we get 15 : 20 : 25.

Check: 25 − 10 = 15 and 25 − 5 = 20. Thus, x = 25, Base = 15, Height = 20.

Area = 1/2 × Base × Height = 1/2 × 15 × 20 = 150 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 150 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides of right triangle are (x − 10), (x − 5) and x.

**Formula Used:** **Pythagoras Theorem**: a² + b² = c², where c is the **hypotenuse** (longest side).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecb263ceaa4082e542082a2edbee714270cd2af897ff268b00054962358eb2d2.png] 

⇒ (x − 10)² + (x − 5)² = x²

⇒ (x² − 20x + 100) + (x² − 10x + 25) = x²

⇒ 2x² − 30x + 125 = x²

⇒ x² − 30x + 125 = 0

⇒ x² − 25x − 5x + 125 = 0

⇒ x(x − 25) − 5(x − 25) = 0

⇒ (x − 25)(x − 5) = 0

⇒ x = 25 or x = 5 (x=5 not possible as side x−5 would be 0 and x−10 would be negative)

⇒ Sides are: 25, (25−5)=20, (25−10)=15

⇒ Area = 1/2 × 15 × 20 = 150 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 150 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Triplets

Sets of three integers that satisfy a² + b² = c², such as (3, 4, 5), (5, 12, 13), and (8, 15, 17).

Area of Right Triangle

Area is calculated as 1/2 × base × height, where base and height are the two legs forming the 90° angle.

Hypotenuse Property

The hypotenuse is always the longest side of a right-angled triangle and is opposite the right angle.</p

questions.question: The length, breadth and height of a cuboid are (2x - 5y + 3) m, (5x + 7y - 7) m, and (x + y + 3) m, respectively. Find the perimeter of the cuboid.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Perimeter** of a **cuboid** = 4 × (Length + Breadth + Height)

Sum of terms = (2x + 5x + x) + (−5y + 7y + y) + (3 − 7 + 3) = 8x + 3y − 1

Perimeter = 4 × (8x + 3y − 1) = 32x + 12y − 4

**∴ The correct answer is (32x + 12y − 4) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length (l)** = (2x − 5y + 3) m

**Breadth (b)** = (5x + 7y − 7) m

**Height (h)** = (x + y + 3) m

**Formula Used:**

**Perimeter of Cuboid** = 4(l + b + h)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5003af47f53029511f4c920eb7ecc52d203fea1d0461fd5dd66cf879b936077e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum = (2x − 5y + 3) + (5x + 7y − 7) + (x + y + 3)

⇒ Sum = (2x + 5x + x) + (−5y + 7y + y) + (3 − 7 + 3)

⇒ Sum = 8x + 3y − 1

⇒ Perimeter = 4 × (8x + 3y − 1)

⇒ Perimeter = 32x + 12y − 4

**∴ The correct answer is (32x + 12y − 4) m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all six faces is given by 2(lb + bh + hl).

Volume of Cuboid

The space occupied by the cuboid is calculated as Length × Breadth × Height.

Diagonal of Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside is √(l² + b² + h²).</p

questions.question: The curved surface area of a right circular cone is 4335pi cm², and the diameter of its base is 102 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the cone.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Identify **Radius (r)** = 102 ÷ 2 = 51 cm.

Using **CSA** = πrl ⇒ 4335π = π × 51 × l ⇒ **Slant height (l)** = 85 cm.

Apply **Pythagorean Triplet** (8, 15, 17) scaled by 5 × 17 = 85, 3 × 17 = 51, 4 × 17 = 68.

**∴ The height is 68 cm.**

**∴ The correct answer is 68 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** = 4335π cm², **Diameter (d)** = 102 cm.

**Formula Used:** CSA = πrl and l² = r² + h²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d286b87fa8dd42c5d814700663b43a21156a1aaae5806036b8fbb3e14d032b06.png] 

⇒ **Radius (r)** = 102 ÷ 2 = 51 cm.

⇒ **π × r × l** = 4335π

⇒ 51 × l = 4335

⇒ l = 4335 ÷ 51 = 85 cm.

⇒ h² = l² − r²

⇒ h² = 85² − 51² = (85 − 51)(85 + 51)

⇒ h² = 34 × 136 = 4624

⇒ h = √4624 = 68 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 68 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cone

The total surface area includes the **CSA** and the **Base Area**: TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume of Cone

The capacity of a cone is exactly one-third the volume of a cylinder with the same base and height: V = (1/3)πr²h.

Relation between l, r, and h

In a right circular cone, the slant height (l), vertical height (h), and radius (r) form a **Right-Angled Triangle**: l² = r² + h².</p

questions.question: A cube of side 5 cm and a cuboid of measurements 35 cm,15 cm and 15 cm, respectively, of the same metal are melted and made into cubes of side 10 cm each. The number of cubes of side 10 cm thus formed is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Volume = Volume of **Cube** + Volume of **Cuboid**

Total Volume = 5³ + (35 × 15 × 15) = 125 + 7875 = 8000 cm³

Number of new cubes = Total Volume ÷ Volume of **New Cube**

Number of new cubes = 8000 ÷ 10³ = 8000 ÷ 1000 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the first **metal cube** (a₁) = 5 cm

Dimensions of the **metal cuboid** = 35 cm × 15 cm × 15 cm

Side of the **newly formed cubes** (a₂) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Cube = (Side)³

Volume of a Cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fb9fdddb54dcb06cfb62b9bec28dfb4738a0f58c14385bbc0ec8490a7f49269.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of small metal cube = 5 × 5 × 5 = 125 cm³

⇒ Volume of metal cuboid = 35 × 15 × 15 = 7875 cm³

⇒ Total volume of metal available = 125 + 7875 = 8000 cm³

⇒ Volume of one new cube = 10 × 10 × 10 = 1000 cm³

⇒ Number of cubes = Total Volume ÷ Volume of one new cube

⇒ Number of cubes = 8000 ÷ 1000 = 8

**∴ The correct answer is 8 cubes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conservation of Volume

When one or more solid objects are **melted** and recast into new shapes, the total **volume remains constant**.

Cuboid Properties

Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(lb + bh + hl) and Diagonal = √(l² + b² + h²).

Cube Properties

Total Surface Area of cube = 6a² and Diagonal = a√3.</p

questions.question: The diagonals of a rhombus are in the ratio 8: 15, and the perimeter is 102 cm. Find the area (in cm²) of the rhombus.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **diagonals** = 8 : 15 → Half-diagonals = 4 : 7.5 → Side ratio = √(4² + 7.5²) = 8.5.

**Perimeter** 102 cm ⇒ **Side** = 102 ÷ 4 = 25.5 cm.

Comparing **side units**: 8.5 units = 25.5 cm ⇒ 1 unit = 3 cm.

Diagonals: d₁ = 8 × 3 = 24 cm, d₂ = 15 × 3 = 45 cm.

**Area** = (1 ÷ 2) × 24 × 45 = 12 × 45 = 540 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 540 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Ratio of diagonals d₁ : d₂ = 8 : 15, Perimeter = 102 cm.

**Formula Used:** Side a = Perimeter ÷ 4; a² = (d₁/2)² + (d₂/2)²; Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/726ffe07ddcacb2478dba5aee8c898bb74497e04b56e7cf901a951b1c892f3be.png] 

⇒ Let d₁ = 8x and d₂ = 15x.

⇒ Side a = 102 ÷ 4 = 25.5 cm.

⇒ a² = (4x)² + (7.5x)²

⇒ (25.5)² = 16x² + 56.25x² = 72.25x²

⇒ 650.25 = 72.25x²

⇒ x² = 650.25 ÷ 72.25 = 9 ⇒ x = 3.

⇒ d₁ = 8 × 3 = 24 cm, d₂ = 15 × 3 = 45 cm.

⇒ Area = (1 ÷ 2) × 24 × 45 = 540 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 540 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rhombus Diagonals

The diagonals of a **rhombus** bisect each other at **right angles** (90°), forming four congruent right-angled triangles.

Side and Diagonal Relationship

The relationship between side 'a' and diagonals 'd₁' and 'd₂' is given by the equation: 4a² = d₁² + d₂².

Area calculation using Trigonometry

If the side 'a' and an internal angle 'θ' are known, **Area** = a² sin(θ).</p

questions.question:

**Calculations:**

questions.question: The curved surface area of a cylinder is half of its total surface area. If its height is 10 cm, then find the volume of the cylinder (in cm³).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** is half of **Total Surface Area (TSA)**, then **CSA = Area of 2 bases**.

2πrh = 2πr² ⇒ **h = r**.

Given **height (h) = 10 cm**, so **radius (r) = 10 cm**.

**Volume = πr²h** = π × 10² × 10 = 1000π cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 1000π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Height (h) = 10 cm; CSA = 1/2 × TSA.

**Formula Used:** CSA = 2πrh; TSA = 2πr(h + r); Volume = πr²h.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c46d640ac2b089d06f0b5537c03f4c3ed22f26c6803ac19f57c7b15bac63f29.png] 

⇒ 2πrh = 1/2 × [2πr(h + r)]

⇒ 2πrh = πr(h + r)

⇒ 2h = h + r

⇒ 2h − h = r ⇒ **r = h**

⇒ r = 10 cm

⇒ Volume = π × (10)² × 10

⇒ Volume = π × 100 × 10 = 1000π cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 1000π cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Cylinder

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh and Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r).

Volume of Cylinder

The space occupied is given by Volume = πr²h.

Ratio of CSA to TSA

The ratio is h : (h + r). In this specific case, 1 : 2 implies h = r.</p

questions.question:
Find the volume (in cm³) of a sphere having a diameter of 4.2 cm, giving your answer correct to two places of decimal.

Take pi=(22)/(7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Radius (r)** = **Diameter** ÷ 2 = 4.2 ÷ 2 = 2.1 cm.

**Volume of Sphere** = (4/3) × π × r³.

Using π ≈ 22/7 ⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 2.1 × 2.1 × 2.1.

Simplified Calculation: 4 × 22 × 0.1 × 2.1 × 2.1 = 8.8 × 4.41 = 38.808 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 38.8 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Diameter (d)** = 4.2 cm

**Radius (r)** = d/2 = 4.2/2 = 2.1 cm

**Formula Used:** Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/151c90d3aad1908b50db29f7f656d072dad35b2a5e6d41ac99999d28199e8b75.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × (2.1)³

⇒ Volume = (4/3) × (22/7) × 2.1 × 2.1 × 2.1

⇒ Volume = 4 × 22 × (2.1/3) × (2.1/7) × 2.1

⇒ Volume = 88 × 0.7 × 0.3 × 2.1

⇒ Volume = 88 × 0.21 × 2.1

⇒ Volume = 88 × 0.441

⇒ Volume = 38.808 cm³

⇒ Rounding to two decimal places = 38.81 cm³ ≈ 38.8 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 38.8 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by the formula 4πr².

Volume of a Hemisphere

A hemisphere is half of a sphere, so its volume is (2/3)πr³.

Curved Surface Area of a Hemisphere

The CSA of a hemisphere is 2πr², and the Total Surface Area (TSA) is 3πr².</p

questions.question: The length of a rectangular field is and breadth is (frac{2a+2sqrt{5}}{4}) m and breadth is (frac{a-sqrt{5}}{2}) m. Find the area of the rectangular field.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Area** of a rectangle = **Length** × **Breadth**

Simplify length: (2a + 2√5) / 4 = 2(a + √5) / 4 = (a + √5) / 2

Area = [(a + √5) / 2] × [(a − √5) / 2]

Using (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y² ⇒ (a² − (√5)²) / 4 = (a² − 5) / 4

**∴ The correct answer is (a² − 5)/4 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length (L)** = (frac{2a+2sqrt{5}}{4}) m

**Breadth (B)** = (frac{a-sqrt{5}}{2}) m

**Formula Used:**

**Area of Rectangle** = **Length** × **Breadth**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/108bcb3d1dacbd741adf930bca385c7c3a5263593e5e4fe0a0e6c56dbc903216.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, simplify the **Length (L)**:

⇒ L = 2(a + √5) / 4

⇒ L = (a + √5) / 2 m

⇒ Now, calculate **Area**:

⇒ Area = [(a + √5) / 2] × [(a − √5) / 2]

⇒ Area = [(a + √5)(a − √5)] / (2 × 2)

⇒ Using identity (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b²:

⇒ Area = (a² − (√5)²) / 4

⇒ Area = (a² − 5) / 4 m²

**∴ The correct answer is (a² − 5)/4 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic Identities

The identity (x + y)(x − y) = x² − y² is frequently used to simplify products involving square roots.

Rectangle Properties

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(Length + Breadth). Diagonal of a rectangle = √(Length² + Breadth²).</p

questions.question: The sides of a triangle are 109 cm, 171 cm, and 100 cm. What is the length (in cm) of its altitude corresponding to the side with a length of 171 cm?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Semi-perimeter (s) = (109 + 171 + 100) ÷ 2 = 190 cm

Area = √[190 × (190 − 109) × (190 − 171) × (190 − 100)]

Area = √[190 × 81 × 19 × 90] = 5130 cm²

Altitude (h) = (2 × Area) ÷ Base = (2 × 5130) ÷ 171 = 60 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Sides **a = 109 cm**, **b = 171 cm**, **c = 100 cm**.

**Formula Used:** Heron's Formula Area = √[s(s − a)(s − b)(s − c)] and Area = (1/2) × base × height.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/471a5cda393df75445a5a81a746c2affd7d139a0a5a7773c409d3dbfe40199d5.png] 

⇒ Semi-perimeter s = (109 + 171 + 100) / 2 = 380 / 2 = 190 cm

⇒ Area = √[190 × (190 − 109) × (190 − 171) × (190 − 100)]

⇒ Area = √[190 × 81 × 19 × 90] = √[19 × 10 × 9² × 19 × 9 × 10]

⇒ Area = 19 × 9 × 10 × 3 = 5130 cm²

⇒ 5130 = (1/2) × 171 × h

⇒ h = (5130 × 2) / 171 = 10260 / 171 = 60 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 60 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Heron's Formula

Used to find the area of a triangle when all three sides are known: Area = √[s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c)], where s is the semi-perimeter.

Altitude of a Triangle

The perpendicular segment from a vertex to the opposite side. Height h = (2 × Area) ÷ base.

Incircle Radius (Inradius)

The radius of the circle inscribed inside a triangle is given by r = Area ÷ s.</p

questions.question:
The volume of a right circular cylinder is 4851 cm³ and its curved surface area is 462 cm². If this cylinder is generated by rotating a rectangle about its length by 360°, what will be the perimeter (in cm) of this rectangle?

Use pi = (22)/(7)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **Volume (V)** to **Curved Surface Area (CSA)** gives radius directly: V / CSA = (πr²h) / (2πrh) = r / 2.

4851 / 462 = r / 2 ⇒ 10.5 = r / 2 ⇒ **r = 21 cm**.

Using CSA: 2 × (22/7) × 21 × h = 462 ⇒ 132 × h = 462 ⇒ **h = 3.5 cm**.

Perimeter of the rectangle = 2(l + b) = 2(h + r) = 2(3.5 + 21) = 49 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 49 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b9a03bbbcb030310a5d776a1993455c26642975954a51d01dad020f3e0524af2.png] 

**Given:** Volume (V) = 4851 cm³, Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 462 cm².

**Formula Used:** Volume = πr²h; CSA = 2πrh; Perimeter of rectangle = 2(length + breadth).

⇒ Dividing V by CSA: (πr²h) / (2πrh) = 4851 / 462

⇒ r / 2 = 10.5

⇒ **r = 21 cm**

⇒ Putting r in CSA: 2 × (22/7) × 21 × h = 462

⇒ 132 × h = 462

⇒ **h = 3.5 cm**

⇒ When a rectangle is rotated about its **length**, height of cylinder (h) = length (l) and radius (r) = breadth (b).

⇒ Perimeter = 2(l + b) = 2(3.5 + 21) = 2 × 24.5 = 49 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 49 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Rotation of Rectangle

If a rectangle is rotated about its **length** (l), then l becomes the **height** (h) and the **breadth** (b) becomes the **radius** (r).

Cylinder Formulas

Total Surface Area = 2πr(h + r). The ratio of Volume to CSA is always r/2.

Perimeter of Rectangle

The distance around the outside of a rectangle, calculated as 2 × (length + width).</p

questions.question: The ratio between the length and the breadth of a rectangular park is 3: 8, and the perimeter of the park is 264 m. Find the area (in m²) of the park.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **length (L)** and **breadth (B)** = 3 : 8

Sum of ratio parts (L + B) = 3 + 8 = 11 units

Perimeter = 2 × (L + B) ⇒ 2 × 11 units = 22 units = 264 m

1 unit = 264 ÷ 22 = 12 m

Area = (3 × 12) × (8 × 12) = 36 × 96 = 3456 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 3456 m².**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Length** (l) to **Breadth** (b) = 3 : 8

**Perimeter** (P) = 264 m

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (l + b)

Area of Rectangle = l × b

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7c8360ae55dbdc02ce7a38dd350ef61ad5346810281df81a8395f273d579050.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the **length** be 3x and the **breadth** be 8x.

⇒ 2 × (3x + 8x) = 264

⇒ 2 × 11x = 264

⇒ 22x = 264

⇒ x = 264 ÷ 22

⇒ x = 12

⇒ Length = 3 × 12 = 36 m

⇒ Breadth = 8 × 12 = 96 m

⇒ Area = 36 × 96

⇒ Area = 3456 m²

**∴ The correct answer is 3456 m².**

**__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

A rectangle is a quadrilateral where opposite sides are equal and all angles are 90°. Diagonal (d) = √(l² + b²).

Area and Perimeter Units

Perimeter is measured in linear units (m, cm), while Area is always measured in square units (m², cm²).

Relationship of Perimeter and Area

For a fixed perimeter, a square has the maximum area among all rectangles.</p

questions.question: The area of a rectangle increases by 7 m² if its length is increased by 6 m and breadth is decreased by 5 m. If the length is decreased by 6 m and breadth is increased by 7 m, then its area increases by 31 m². What is the perimeter of the original rectangle (in m)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **length** be L and **breadth** be B.

From given conditions: (L + 6)(B − 5) = LB + 7 ⇒ −5L + 6B = 37

And: (L − 6)(B + 7) = LB + 31 ⇒ 7L − 6B = 73

Adding equations: 2L = 110 ⇒ L = 55 m; Substituting L: 6B = 37 + 275 = 312 ⇒ B = 52 m

**Perimeter** = 2 × (55 + 52) = 2 × 107 = 214 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 214 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial **Area** = LB. Two conditions for change in dimensions.

**Formula:** **Area of rectangle** = Length × Breadth | **Perimeter** = 2(L + B)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/057e6747120d869877c0500c5aa626a83931961909bfeb4c696c98f8e7898991.png] 

**Case 1:** (L + 6)(B − 5) = LB + 7

⇒ LB − 5L + 6B − 30 = LB + 7

⇒ −5L + 6B = 37 ... (i)

**Case 2:** (L − 6)(B + 7) = LB + 31

⇒ LB + 7L − 6B − 42 = LB + 31

⇒ 7L − 6B = 73 ... (ii)

**Solving (i) and (ii):**

⇒ (−5L + 6B) + (7L − 6B) = 37 + 73

⇒ 2L = 110 ⇒ **Length** = 55 m

⇒ −5(55) + 6B = 37 ⇒ −275 + 6B = 37 ⇒ 6B = 312 ⇒ **Breadth** = 52 m

⇒ **Perimeter** = 2(55 + 52) = 2(107) = 214 m

**∴ The correct answer is 214 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of Rectangle

Opposite sides are equal and parallel. All internal angles are 90°. **Diagonal** = √(L² + B²).

Percentage Change in Area

If length increases by x% and breadth increases by y%, net area change = [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Relationship between Perimeter and Area

For a given **perimeter**, a **square** (L=B) has the maximum **area** among all rectangles.</p

questions.question: The sum of the area of two squares whose sides are p cm and q cm, respectively, is 317 cm² and the sum of their perimeters is 100 cm. Find the product of p and q.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of perimeters ⇒ 4(p + q) = 100 ⇒ **p + q = 25**

Sum of areas ⇒ p² + q² = 317

Using identity: (p + q)² = p² + q² + 2pq

25² = 317 + 2pq ⇒ 625 − 317 = 2pq ⇒ 308 = 2pq

pq = 154

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01a96ceded0d0441a66704bafb2ffcd81ec6d6d168b199d3da254bd283f1bcc4.png] 

**Given:**

Area of square 1 + Area of square 2 = 317 cm²

Perimeter of square 1 + Perimeter of square 2 = 100 cm

**Formula Used:**

Area of square = **side²**

Perimeter of square = **4 × side**

Algebraic identity: **(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab**

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4p + 4q = 100

⇒ 4(p + q) = 100

⇒ p + q = 25

⇒ p² + q² = 317

⇒ (p + q)² = p² + q² + 2pq

⇒ (25)² = 317 + 2pq

⇒ 625 = 317 + 2pq

⇒ 2pq = 625 − 317

⇒ 2pq = 308

⇒ pq = 154

**∴ The correct answer is 154 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Square

A square has four equal sides and four right angles. The diagonal of a square is √2 × side.

Algebraic Identities

Useful in geometry: (a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab and a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b).

Diagonal and Area Relationship

The area of a square can also be calculated as (Diagonal)² ÷ 2.</p

questions.question: The sum of the lengths of the edges of a cube is equal to the sum of the lengths of the edges of a cuboid whose length, breadth and height are in the ratio 4:3: 1. Find the volume (in cm³) of the cuboid if the volume of the cube is 512 cm³.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Cube edge** (a) = √³512 = 8 cm.

Total **Cube edge sum** = 12 × 8 = 96 cm.

Total **Cuboid edge sum** = 4 × (4x + 3x + x) = 32x.

Equating sums: 32x = 96 ⇒ x = 3.

**Cuboid Volume** = (4 × 3) × (3 × 3) × (1 × 3) = 12 × 9 × 3 = 324 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 324 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of cube = 512 cm³.

Ratio of cuboid dimensions (L:B:H) = 4 : 3 : 1.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cube = a³ | Sum of edges of cube = 12a

Sum of edges of cuboid = 4(L + B + H) | Volume of cuboid = L × B × H

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a706408c2556a71a3bda5473491937bc30f0c0e990ffeba4d10e4f1f82b2412.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 512 ⇒ a = 8 cm.

⇒ Sum of edges of cube = 12 × 8 = 96 cm.

⇒ Let cuboid dimensions be 4x, 3x, and 1x.

⇒ Sum of edges of cuboid = 4(4x + 3x + x) = 4(8x) = 32x.

⇒ 32x = 96 ⇒ x = 3 cm.

⇒ Length (L) = 4 × 3 = 12 cm, Breadth (B) = 3 × 3 = 9 cm, Height (H) = 1 × 3 = 3 cm.

⇒ Volume of cuboid = 12 × 9 × 3 = 324 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 324 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total area of all six faces is 2(LB + BH + LH).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can be placed inside is √(L² + B² + H²).

Lateral Surface Area of Cube

The area of the four vertical walls of a cube is 4a².</p
